description: List canvas dataframes materialized by fedreserve_get_observations, with provenance, TTL, column schema, and row count. Optionally filter to a single dataframe by name. Requires CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb.

name.description: Optional table name (df_XXXXX_XXXXX) to describe a single dataframe. Omit to list all.

name: fedreserve_dataframe_describe

dataframes.description: Active dataframes for this tenant, newest first. Empty when none are registered.

items.description: Provenance and schema for one dataframe.

column_schema.description: Resolved column schema. All FRED dataframe columns are nullable.

items.description: One column declaration in the dataframe schema.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry timestamp. Sliding TTL refreshed on every dataframe op.

max_rows.description: Materialization cap that produced truncated, when applicable.

query_params.description: Input parameters the source tool was called with.

truncated.description: True when the upstream source had more rows than were materialized.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: The DataCanvas service is not configured for this deployment. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: Describe FRED Dataframes
